summary: Unsigned Clarence Road kerb where cars park; homes 12-20 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 15-19 m away on the west side; apartments 12 m at 30 m, flats and houses opposite 17 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane where several cars are parked; room for a van in line.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here day to day and no signs are mapped, so a van fits in.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees on the east side shade the road in the morning.

best_section.where: Clarence Road west kerb, midway between the two junctions
